title: Refero Design Styles
brief: A library of 2,000+ "AI-readable" design systems harvested from leading product websites (Apple, Cursor, Linear, Vercel, ElevenLabs). Each style exposes colors, typography, spacing, and components plus a DESIGN.md file meant to be fed into Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, v0, or Lovable to give AI builders better design taste; currently in beta with new styles added weekly.
details: Refero Styles is a library of 2,000+ AI-readable design systems harvested from leading product websites (Apple, OpenAI, Linear, Figma, Vercel, and more), with new styles added every week. Each entry documents colors, typography, spacing, and components, and ships a DESIGN.md file you can drop into Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, v0, or Lovable so your AI assistant generates interfaces with real product-grade design taste instead of generic output.
